title: docs: prioritize 🔮 Next Phase (N.1–N.5) as current active development focus
body:
All Q1–Q3 foundation work and Console v1.0 are complete. Restructures ROADMAP.md to elevate the Next Phase (N.1–N.5) from a future appendix into the current active priority.

### Changes

- **Section promotion:** Moved 🔮 Next Phase from after Q4 to before Q4, reflecting actual execution order
- **Priority tiers with rationale:**
  - 🔴 P0: N.1 (v3.0.0 Deep Integration) + N.2 (Designer Completion) — foundation for all downstream work
  - 🟡 P1: N.3 (Ecosystem & Marketplace) + N.4 (Community Growth) — growth engines, depend on P0
  - 🔵 P2: N.5 (2027 Platform Vision) — strategic long-term bets
- **Deduplication:** Consolidated Designer phases 2–4 from Q2.8 into cross-references to N.2 (was duplicated)
- **Cross-references:** Q3 marketplace (3.5) and community (3.6) items now point to N.3/N.4
- **Annual Targets table:** Added N.x mapping per quarter, Designer Completion row, Community (Discord) row
- **Header/footer:** Added `Current Priority` metadata field; updated roadmap status line
